name: 086.4 — a timer answers for itself
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 086.4: hafen.timer()'s documented filter means something, because the handle it is called with answers :interval(), :repeats(), :due(), :alive() and :info(); the handle is userdata, so a write to it and a typo on it both raise; and hafen.timer():every(0, fn) repeats instead of firing once.
